html:
ViTMatte (Huazhong University of Science and Technology, 2023): refines a rough trimap (sure background, sure foreground, unknown band) into a soft alpha matte, e.g. hair and fur edges; a plain Vision Transformer plus a small detail decoder; small and base versions. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: ViTMatte: Boosting Image Matting with Pretrained Plain Vision Transformers, Information Fusion 2024, 2023-05-24
  • Original code: https://github.com/hustvl/ViTMatte at 8cd7ef068380
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/hustvl/vitmatte-small-composition-1k/blob/6a58ad7646403c1df626fbd746900aec7361ea1d/README.md ; https://huggingface.co/hustvl/vitmatte-base-composition-1k/blob/bf486d01a7d9e3dbcc8400f7942835caf0eaf76e/README.md ; https://github.com/hustvl/ViTMatte/blob/8cd7ef068380977c3962c4cb733cb1fe7f2241a5/LICENSE
  • Training data: Composition-1k (Adobe Deep Image Matting) (The HF cards: "ViTMatte model trained on Composition-1k". Adobe Deep Image Matting (Composition-1k) is released for non-commercial research on request; only the weights licence (Apache-2.0) counts for the commercial flag.)
  • Kernel libraries: dpt_fused, cudnn_hacc, igev, cutlass_conv
  • Variants: vitmatte-s, vitmatte-b
  • Outputs: alpha
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): vitmatte-s 3000x4000 (7.8 GiB peak allocated, 13.9 reserved); vitmatte-b 3000x4000 (8.0 GiB peak allocated, 14.3 reserved)
  • vitmatte-s 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 31 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 51 s (ONNX + engine).
  • vitmatte-b 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 33 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 49 s (ONNX + engine).
  • vitmatte-s original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); transformers 5.19.0 VitMatteForImageMatting, normalise / trimap / pad 32 / crop
  • vitmatte-b original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); transformers 5.19.0 VitMatteForImageMatting, normalise / trimap / pad 32 / crop
  • vitmatte-s load / first call: original 2.85 s / 0.722 s, portable 0.16 s / 0.413 s, kernels 1.3 s / 0.202 s
  • vitmatte-b load / first call: original 0.21 s / 0.562 s, portable 0.52 s / 0.35 s, kernels 1.32 s / 0.249 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Trimap-guided models, AIM-500: each image at its own size with a trimap made from its alpha (alpha 255 / 0 eroded by a 21 px ellipse = foreground / background, the rest unknown); SAD / 1000 and MSE of the 8-bit alpha in the unknown region (ViTMatte's evaluation). Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 5.8e-06 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 5.3e-05 and p99 <= 0.0012 (absolute error of the output alpha).
